data.title: 五更琉璃 · 晨风窗纱下的安宁凝眸
data.description: 清晨的薄风吹起窗前轻柔的白纱，淡金色的朝阳洒在少女白皙如瓷的脸庞上。琉璃靠坐在窗边的软垫上，只穿着一件略显宽大的黑色印花长T恤，露出一侧圆润的雪肩与光洁锁骨。手中端着温热的红茶杯，姬发式齐刘海在晨风中轻轻晃动，嘴角泛着难得恬淡舒心的温柔微笑，眼眸清澈明亮。
data.location: sun-drenched bedroom with billowing white sheer curtains
data.action: sitting by window on soft cushion holding warm teacup, oversized black t-shirt slipping off shoulder, morning breeze blowing white sheer curtains, serene affectionate smile
data.lighting: pure cool early morning daylight warming into golden sunbeam
data.mood: serene domestic peace, pure unfiltered affection
data.promptProse: Sitting beside an open window with sheer curtains dancing in the breeze, Kuroneko holds a cup of hot tea in an oversized black shirt. Her bare shoulder catches morning light as she smiles with peaceful contentment.
data.animaCaption: Kuroneko sitting by a morning window with tea in an oversized t-shirt, smiling serenely.
